dominant_strengths: Authentic Apple navigation pattern with crisp SF-style type and proper hierarchy between section headline and supporting copy
Disciplined dark palette with restrained blue accents creates focused, premium product-page atmosphere consistent with brand
Clean carousel pagination affordance sits unobtrusively, signaling interactivity without competing with content
dominant_weaknesses: Massive empty band between nav and headline wastes vertical real estate, breaking rhythm and making the scroll feel hollow
Carousel card is largely empty black space — promised highlights have no visual payload, undermining the 'highlights' promise
Headline and 'Watch the film' link float far apart on the same row with no visual tension or grouping logic
fix_priorities: Populate the carousel card with actual product imagery or chip visualization to deliver on the highlights headline
Tighten vertical spacing above headline and introduce a subtle section divider or eyebrow to anchor the block
Re-pair 'Watch the film' link closer to its semantic parent or restyle as a CTA chip beneath the headline
rationale.norman_balance: Behavioral clarity is solid via familiar Apple patterns, but visceral impact is muted by emptiness and reflective payoff is weak without imagery.
rationale.intent_fit: Recognizably mimics an Apple MacBook Pro scroll state but captures a transitional empty frame rather than a resolved hero moment.
